cohort: The study included all births >= 22 weeks of gestation that occurred in a tertiary university hospital in Besancon, France, from January 1st, 2017, to December 31st, 2023.
finding: An average Caesarean section rate below 15% was achieved without increasing maternal and neonatal complications in a tertiary university hospital.
mod_finding: A significant reduction of the overall CS rate from 15.4% to 13.0% was observed between 2020 and 2023, primarily driven by reductions in Robson Group 5 and a trend in Group 6.
